name: Wall Sit with Band Pull-Apart
description: A combination hold: sit in a 90° squat against a wall, and while you hold it, do band pull-aparts at chest height, squeezing your shoulder blades.

source.title: Band Pull-Aparts (Hinge Health)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet forward.
Hold a band at chest height with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Slide down into a 90° squat: thighs about level, knees over ankles.
cues: Keep your whole back on the wall through the hold.
Pull the band outward until it touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return under control; keep your arms straight.
Breathe steadily; don't hold your breath.

prescription.note: Do 12 to 15 pull-aparts while you hold the wall sit, then stand up and rest.

keyframes.name: Back to the wall
keyframes.cue: Feet forward, band held out in front at chest height.

keyframes.name: Slide down
keyframes.cue: Slide down into a 90° wall sit.

keyframes.name: Arms forward
keyframes.cue: Hold the sit; arms straight, hands shoulder-width.

keyframes.name: Pull apart
keyframes.cue: Pull the band out to your chest and squeeze your shoulder blades.

keyframes.name: Return
keyframes.cue: Bring your hands back together under control.

keyframes.name: Stand up
keyframes.cue: When the set is done, turn and slide back up the wall.
